name: fskill
description: Engineering workflow skills for Codex, with /catchup reporting, /think for planning and calibration, and /f-help guidance and explicit /f-mode session routing. Direct commands remain available.

interface.longDescription: fskill packages ten engineering workflow skills (planning, debugging, review, UI, research, writing, handoff, reporting, retro, and health) plus /f-mode routing and /f-help guidance. /f-mode routes only after you enter it. Enter any skill with /name or $name; think, hunt, and check also start on their own when the task is theirs, while the other nine wait for an explicit call.
defaultPrompt: Use fskill think to plan this change
Use fskill check to review this diff
Use fskill hunt to debug this failure
